instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

sections.section_title:
Q.1 Choose the correct answer of the following (Any seven questions
                    only):

questions.text: Which of the following words is the antonym of "ephemeral"?
Which of the following is a synonym for "verbose"?
Which of the following sentences demonstrates correct comma usage?
options: She went to the store and bought apples, oranges, and bananas.
She went to the store, and bought apples oranges and bananas.
She went to the store and bought, apples, oranges, and bananas.
She went to the store and bought, apples oranges, and bananas.

questions.text: Identify the sentence with the correct subject-verb agreement:
options: The team of students are preparing for the competition.
Neither of the options seems suitable for me.
The dogs in the neighbourhood barks loudly at night.
Each of the candidates have submitted their resumes.

questions.text: Which of the following is a synonym for "exuberant"?
Which of the following is an antonym for "brave"?
Which of the following excerpts best exemplifies a formal writing style?
options: "Hey there! How are you? Just wanted to check in and see how things are going."
"Dear Sir/Madam, I am writing to inquire about the current status of my application."
"Yo, what's up? Can you tell me what's happening with the project?"

"Hey folks, hope all is well! Just dropping a line to see if anyone has updates on our
                            upcoming event."

questions.text: Which of the following is a key component of effective oral communication?
options: Speaking as quickly as possible to convey information efficiently.
Using complex vocabulary to impress the audience.
Maintaining eye contact and using appropriate body language.
Focusing solely on one's own perspective without considering the audience's needs.

questions.text: Which of the following is an essential professional skill in the workplace?
Which of the following is an example of a soft skill?
Describe the importance of vocabulary building in academic and professional contexts. Discuss strategies and resources that individuals can utilize to improve their vocabulary effectively.
Explain the significance of effective oral communication skills in personal and professional settings.
How can leaders cultivate emotional intelligence skills to create a positive and productive work environment?
Differentiate between Phonetics and Phonology? Explain IPA with some symbols. Discuss the challenges posed by mother tongue influence in acquiring fluency in a second language.
Define coherence and fluency in the context of speech communication? Discuss how coherence and fluency contribute to effective verbal communication in everyday interactions.
What are the roles of Soft Skills and explain how soft skills such as communication, teamwork, adaptability, or problem-solving contribute to improved workplace dynamics and productivity.

Explain the significance of etiquettes such as respectfulness, punctuality, and effective communication in creating a positive work environment. Describe how these skills enhance professional success.
Discuss the concept of technology-aided language learning (TALL) and its impact on language acquisition and education. Explain the various forms of technology used in TALL and their benefits.

options: Vowel, Consonant Pronunciation, Intonation, Stress and Rhythm
